name: Sunday at Eastminster
status: standalone. The world (knox-world.js) has no renderer, camera, player or loop, so it can be poured; the trough has no Knoxville island yet, and its vehicles (tractor, wagon, helicopter) and paint belong to the trough's vocabulary once they are there.

frame.origin: Magnolia Avenue in front of the church
frame.scale: about 1:10 for distances; landmarks near true size

places: World's Fair Park and the Sunsphere
the Tennessee River and its bridges
physics: Rapier: heightfield ground, static walls, dynamic trash cans and hay bales, the wagon bed as a kinematic body
motion: Mesh2Motion clips through m2m-world-bridge.js: walk, jog, rope-pull, push, idle-talking, farm-watering, idle-foldarms
